task_objective: Assess whether a guarded implementation workflow may move from launch preparation into coding start without accepting a false state transition.

text_first_baseline.input_summary: Broad text bundle from workflow notes, launch criteria, process-transition notes and implementation guidance.

gates: coding start only after launch state is valid

expected.transition_boundary: ready-to-code or planning state must not be promoted to implementation-written without a valid launch record and transition evidence
expected.evidence_boundary: transition assessment may permit, block or request evidence; it may not claim that implementation has been completed

limitations: Fixture seed reuses public synthetic method-inspection data.
Execution scoring is stored separately in the execution record.
Reviewer scoring is non-independent until an external or separated reviewer is added.
